name: [avd-ops] Persistent Host & Cloud PC Winget-AutoUpdate (WAU)
description: Declarative Winget-AutoUpdate (MIT) configuration for persistent personal AVD hosts and Windows 365 Cloud PCs. Excluded from pooled multi-session hosts, which update via Evergreen golden image builds.

psadtInterop.note: Operators may wrap custom LOB apps with user-supplied PSADT v4 packages (Invoke-AppDeployToolkit.exe / Deploy-Application.exe) without bundling LGPL-2.1 code into avd-intune.
